Dhol mandar | mundari lok nrity ki manmohak prastuti | meghnath munda evan sathi | Munda Tribal Folk Dance | Jharkhand Culture | DD Jharkhand
Jharkhand ki samriddh janjatiy sanskriti men lok nrity aur lokgiton ka vishesh sthan hai. yahan ki paranpraen prakriti, ritu parivartan, kheti-kisani aur parv-tyoharon se gahraee se juri huee hain. inhin jivant sanskritik paranpraon men se ek hai mundari lok nrity, jo munda janjati ki samuhik jivanshaili, prakriti ke prati jurav aur sanskritik pahchan ko khubsurti se prastut karta hai.
